data.narrative:
Applied Atomics, a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Ben Kellie and Paul Keutelian, has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broad nuclear energy comp universe of 11 total peers—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy. However, the narrow peer set constrained methodology applicability.

Stage-progression analysis, the sole applicable triangulation method, anchors on the $8M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $20M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while 6 same-sector comparables exist, filtering for matching stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier peers produced insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3 required for statistical reliability), making an all-sector median uninformative.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $17M–$23M, with a median point of $20M. Key uncertainties center on the sparse narrow-peer universe—Applied Atomics occupies a crowded but heterogeneous sector where stage-matched private comparables remain limited. Any valuation conclusion relies heavily on the stage-progression multiple and would benefit from additional near-peer financials as the nuclear energy sector matures and disclosure improves.
